abstract.t:
Without a structured address allocation plan, early space missions risk creating an unaggregated patchwork of prefixes, repeating the historical operational scaling issues seen in terrestrial networks.
This document requests that the IANA allocate address space specifically for use in space environments and manages suballocations from that block for and within celestial bodies, as needed. The Number Resource Organization (NRO) will determine how to allocate and assign address resources for and within the celestial bodies , with the understanding that topological address aggregation is critical for routing scalability and operational efficiency.
